card.name: Closing punctuation after medical terms
card.fires_on: Closing brackets, commas and the last piece of a term at the end of a drug, condition or lab-value phrase in label text. It fires where a phrase has just finished and a modifying or linking word could come next.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis or comma
modes.description: A bracket or comma ends a list of drugs or conditions.
modes.example: drugs that can reduce bone mass (e.g., anticonvulsants, oral corticosteroids<<)>> should be monitored

modes.label: End of a term
modes.description: The last piece of a drug or condition name or unit, just before the phrase continues.
modes.example: Continuing guanfacine extended-release tablets while stopping a CYP3A4 mod<<ulator>> CYP3A4 Strong and moderate

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning "caused by" or "used", which attach a modifier to a noun phrase that has just ended.
card.plain: It marks the end of a drug or condition phrase, where a qualifying phrase could follow.
